🚨 ACTION ANNOUNCEMENT
📅 Thursday, October 9th
⏰ 5:00 PM
📍 New York Times Building (620 8th Ave) 
📣 Bring your rage

Israel’s genocide of Palestine has reached its cruelest stage of mass starvation and destruction. Meanwhile, corporate media like The New York Times — after two years of supporting U.S.-backed genocide — continues to downplay Israel’s responsibility for these horrors.

In an article on Oct 5, 2025, disgraced NYT “journalist” Isabel Kershner refers to Israel’s illegal blockade and deliberate starving of Gaza as a “humanitarian crisis”. Palestinian suffering did not come out of nowhere — it is the result of Israel’s planned campaign of death and ethnic cleansing.

The New York Times must be held accountable for their blatant manipulation. Raise your voice and bring your anger to the core of U.S. Zionist propaganda. They cannot bury the truth!

#MediaComplicity #UnsubscribefromtheNYT #FreePalestine
